youtube_description:
I was curious to find out why and how Turkey shares a border with Azerbaijan. So walked to Nakhchivan from Turkey to Nakhchivan. Basically walking in between Iran, Armenia, Turkey and Azerbaijan. Hitchhiking from Iğdır aka Reşqelas, Իգդիր and Ցոլակերտ Tsolakert

The two border villages that connect the highway between the counties are Dilucu, Aralık, Türkiye to Sədərək, Naxçıvan, Azərbaycan. 

Whilst walking I saw Turkey and mount Ararat also know as Մասիս, Masis, Արարատ, Grîdax, Çiyayê Agirî and Ağrı Dağı.
